repo_summary: a small Python repo that scans reusable skill folders and exports a machine-readable catalog for internal agent workflows
key_files: scripts/build_catalog.py parses SKILL.md files and writes catalog/skills_index.json
skills/*/SKILL.md holds the human-facing metadata and examples for each skill
tests/test_catalog.py validates the exported catalog structure
README.md explains how internal teams consume the generated index
realism_notes: Requests usually mention benchmark coverage, pairing recommendations, or validation rules for skill metadata
Practical asks often touch both the generated catalog and the human-readable README
The repo is still small, so a good task stays scoped to one export path or one validation rule at a time
